text.tspan: SecurityConfig maps both paths to authenticated so the filter has already validated the token

svg.text: POST /api/auth/logout with the Bearer header or the cookie
authenticated request
extractToken reads the Authorization header first then the cookie
clearAuthCookie
400 Authentication token is missing
blacklistToken token
INSERT into token_blacklist unless a row for this token already exists
getSessionIdFromToken reads the sessionId claim
UPDATE sessions set is_active false and logout_timestamp now
clearAuthCookie writes Set-Cookie with an empty value and max-age 0
200 Successfully logged out
POST /api/auth/logout-all
authenticated request with the User entity as the principal
findByUser which returns every row not only the active ones
SELECT sessions by user_id
saveAll with is_active false and logout_timestamp now
blacklistToken for the current token only
INSERT into token_blacklist
clearAuthCookie
200 Logged out from all devices successfully
